name: chronexa-ws-manager
description: CLI to create, edit, and delete Windows services via sc.exe

scripts.build:host: cd service-host/ChronexaServiceHost && dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o ./publish && mkdir -p ../../assets && cp ./publish/chronexa-service-host.exe ../../assets/chronexa-service-host.exe
scripts.build:all: npm run build:host && npm run build:exe
